reason: The hypothesis transfers the crack-arresting graphene interface concept from nanolayered CoCrFeNi/graphene composites (P11, P15) to a completely different caloric MM'X alloy system, (MnNiSi)0.62(FeCoGe)0.38, and couples it with the requirement to preserve a functional caloric response, a combination not proposed or tested in any passage.
